+<!DOCTYPE html>
+<html lang="en">
+<head>
+    <meta charset="UTF-8">
+    <title>JSEvaluator Regression Tests</title>
+    <style>
+        body {
+            font-family: monospace;
+            margin: 20px;
+            background: #111;
+            color: #0f0;
+        }
+
+        table {
+            width: 100%;
+            border-collapse: collapse;
+        }
+
+        th, td {
+            padding: 8px;
+            border: 1px solid #333;
+            text-align: left;
+        }
+
+        .pass {
+            background: #0a0;
+            color: white;
+        }
+
+        .fail {
+            background: #a00;
+            color: white;
+        }
+
+        pre {
+            background: #222;
+            padding: 10px;
+            overflow: auto;
+        }
+    </style>
+</head>
+<body>
+    <h1>JSEvaluator Test Suite</h1>
+    <button onclick="runAllTests()">Run All Tests</button>
+    <table id="results">
+        <thead>
+            <tr>
+                <th>Test Name</th>
+                <th>Expected</th>
+                <th>Actual</th>
+                <th>Status</th>
+            </tr>
+        </thead>
+        <tbody></tbody>
+    </table>
+
+    <script>
+        // These tests will be executed via the engine's JSContext / JSEvaluator
+        const tests = [
+            { name: "Basic variable assignment", code: "let x = 42; x;", expected: 42 },
+            { name: "Math operations", code: "let x = 10; let y = 20; x + y * 2;", expected: 50 },
+            { name: "User-defined function", code: "function add(a,b){return a+b;} add(5,7);", expected: 12 },
+            { name: "Factorial recursion", code: "function fact(n){return n<=1?1:n*fact(n-1);} fact(5);", expected: 120 },
+            { name: "Object and property access", code: "let p = {name:'test', value:99}; p.value;", expected: 99 },
+            { name: "Array operations", code: "let arr=[1,2,3]; arr.push(4); arr.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);", expected: 10 },
+            { name: "Closure / scope", code: "function makeCounter(){let c=0;return ()=>++c;} let counter=makeCounter(); counter(); counter();", expected: 2 },
+            { name: "This binding", code: "let obj={val:10, double:function(){return this.val*2;}}; obj.double();", expected: 20 },
+            { name: "String interpolation", code: "let name='Core'; `Hello ${name}`;", expected: "Hello Core" },
+            { name: "Error handling", code: "try{throw new Error('test');}catch(e){e.message;}", expected: "test" },
+            { name: "Control flow (if/else)", code: "let x=5; if(x>3) 'high' else 'low';", expected: "high" },
+            { name: "Loop sum", code: "let sum=0; for(let i=1;i<=10;i++) sum+=i; sum;", expected: 55 }
+        ];
+
+        function runTest(test) {
+            let actual;
+            try {
+                // This is where the engine's JSContext.Run() would be called
+                // For testing purposes we simulate it here. In real engine use, replace with:
+                // actual = window.runJS ? window.runJS(test.code) : eval(test.code);
+                actual = eval(test.code); // fallback for standalone testing
+            } catch (e) {
+                actual = "ERROR: " + e.message;
+            }
+
+            const passed = actual === test.expected ||
+                          (typeof actual === 'number' && typeof test.expected === 'number' && Math.abs(actual - test.expected) < 0.0001);
+
+            return {
+                name: test.name,
+                expected: test.expected,
+                actual: actual,
+                passed: passed
+            };
+        }
+
+        function runAllTests() {
+            const tbody = document.querySelector('#results tbody');
+            tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+            tests.forEach(test => {
+                const result = runTest(test);
+
+                const row = document.createElement('tr');
+                row.className = result.passed ? 'pass' : 'fail';
+
+                row.innerHTML = `
+                    <td>${result.name}</td>
+                    <td>${JSON.stringify(result.expected)}</td>
+                    <td>${JSON.stringify(result.actual)}</td>
+                    <td>${result.passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}</td>
+                `;
+                tbody.appendChild(row);
+            });
+
+            console.log("All JS evaluator tests finished.");
+        }
+
+        // Auto-run when page loads (for convenience)
+        window.onload = runAllTests;
+    </script>
+</body>
+</html>

+﻿// Folder: Keystone
+// File: ProjectStateManager.cs
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Terrain;
+using SiegeEngine.Scenes;
+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+
+namespace Keystone
+{
+    public class ProjectStateManager
+    {
+        public static ProjectStateManager Current { get; } = new ProjectStateManager();
+
+        private readonly Dictionary<string, LiveSceneState> _liveStates = new Dictionary<string, LiveSceneState>();
+
+        public LiveSceneState GetOrCreateLiveState(string sceneName, int width = 200, int height = 200)
+        {
+            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceneName)) return null;
+
+            if (!_liveStates.TryGetValue(sceneName, out var state))
+            {
+                state = new LiveSceneState(sceneName, width, height);
+                _liveStates[sceneName] = state;
+                Console.WriteLine($"[ProjectStateManager] Created LiveSceneState for '{sceneName}' ({width}x{height})");
+            }
+            return state;
+        }
+
+        public LiveSceneState GetLiveState(string sceneName)
+        {
+            _liveStates.TryGetValue(sceneName, out var state);
+            return state;
+        }
+
+        public void BindSceneToLiveState(string sceneName, GameScene scene)
+        {
+            if (scene is TerrainScene terrainScene)
+            {
+                var state = GetOrCreateLiveState(sceneName);
+                terrainScene.BindLiveState(state);
+                Console.WriteLine($"[ProjectStateManager] Bound live state to TerrainScene '{sceneName}'");
+            }
+        }
+
+        public void StoreUnsavedHeightmap(string sceneName, float[,] heightmap)
+        {
+            var state = GetLiveState(sceneName);
+            if (state != null && heightmap != null)
+            {
+                state.Heightmap = heightmap;
+                state.HeightmapVersion++;
+            }
+        }
+
+        public float[,] GetUnsavedHeightmap(string sceneName)
+        {
+            var state = GetLiveState(sceneName);
+            return state?.Heightmap;
+        }
+

+        {
+            if (sceneName == null && sceneData != null) sceneName = sceneData.Name;
+
+            var state = GetOrCreateLiveState(sceneName);
+            if (heightmap != null)
+            {
+                state.Heightmap = heightmap;
+            }
+
+            // Direct assignment (now allowed by internal setters in ProjectSettings)
+            ProjectSettings.Current.CurrentSceneData = sceneData;
+            ProjectSettings.Current.CurrentHeightmap = heightmap;
+            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceneName)) ProjectSettings.Current.CurrentSceneName = sceneName;
+
+            Console.WriteLine($"[ProjectStateManager] SetCurrentTerrain - live state updated for '{sceneName}'");
+        }

+        public void Clear()
+        {
+            foreach (var state in _liveStates.Values) state.Dispose();
+            _liveStates.Clear();
+        }

+﻿// Folder: ToolChest
+// File: BrushPanel.cs
+using Keystone;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.ContextManagement;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Events;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Interfaces;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Rendering;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.UI;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.UI.Elements;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Managers;
+using System;
+using System.IO;
+using System.Linq;
+using System.Numerics;
+using System.Text;
+namespace ToolChest
+{
+    public class BrushPanel : BasePanel
+    {
+        private class BrushUIOverlay : UIOverlay
+        {
+            private readonly BrushPanel _parent;
+            public BrushUIOverlay(BrushPanel parent, IRenderContext renderContext, IControlContext controlContext, nint window)
+                : base(renderContext, controlContext, window)
+            {
+                _parent = parent;
+            }
+            protected override void HandleDataHook(string hook)
+            {
+                _parent.HandleBrushDataHook(hook);
+            }
+        }
+        private Brush _currentBrush = new Brush();
+        private string _lastMode = "Raise";
+        public BrushPanel(IRenderContext renderContext, IControlContext controlContext, nint window, EventBus eventBus)
+            : base(renderContext, controlContext, window, eventBus)
+        {
+            HasTitleBar = true;
+            IsClosable = true;
+            DockingMode = SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions.DockingMode.IDE;
+            AllowDragging = true;
+            DockState = DockState.Floating;
+        }
+        protected override UIOverlay CreateUIOverlay()
+        {
+            return new BrushUIOverlay(this, _renderContext, _controlContext, _window);
+        }
+        public override void Init()
+        {
+            base.Init();
+            chrome.close_color = new Vector4(0.486f, 1.0f, 0.796f, 1.0f);
+            LoadBrushUI();
+            PublishCurrentBrush();
+            RefreshMaterialDropdown();
+        }
+        private void LoadBrushUI()
+        {
+            string htmlPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "BrushPanelUI.html");
+            if (File.Exists(htmlPath))
+            {
+                _uiOverlay.LoadUI(File.ReadAllText(htmlPath));
+            }
+            _uiOverlay.RefreshUI();
+        }
+        private void HandleBrushDataHook(string hook)
+        {
+            bool changed = false;
+            if (hook == "BrushSizeChanged")
+            {
+                var slider = _uiOverlay.FindElementById("sizeSlider") as InputElement;
+                if (slider != null)
+                {
+                    float size = float.Parse(slider.Value ?? "10");
+                    _currentBrush.Size = size;
+                    changed = true;
+                }
+            }
+            else if (hook == "BrushIntensityChanged")
+            {
+                var slider = _uiOverlay.FindElementById("intensitySlider") as InputElement;
+                if (slider != null)
+                {
+                    float intensity = float.Parse(slider.Value ?? "1");
+                    _currentBrush.Intensity = intensity;
+                    changed = true;
+                }
+            }
+            else if (hook == "BrushShapeChanged")
+            {
+                var select = _uiOverlay.FindElementsByTag("select").FirstOrDefault(el => el.Attributes.GetValueOrDefault("data-hook", "") == "BrushShapeChanged") as SelectElement;
+                if (select != null)
+                {
+                    string shapeStr = select.Value ?? "Circle";
+                    _currentBrush.Shape = (BrushShape)Enum.Parse(typeof(BrushShape), shapeStr, true);
+                    changed = true;
+                }
+            }
+            else if (hook == "BrushFalloffChanged")
+            {
+                var select = _uiOverlay.FindElementsByTag("select").FirstOrDefault(el => el.Attributes.GetValueOrDefault("data-hook", "") == "BrushFalloffChanged") as SelectElement;
+                if (select != null)
+                {
+                    string falloffStr = select.Value ?? "Gaussian";
+                    _currentBrush.Falloff = (BrushFalloff)Enum.Parse(typeof(BrushFalloff), falloffStr, true);
+                    changed = true;
+                }
+            }
+            else if (hook == "BrushModeChanged")
+            {
+                var select = _uiOverlay.FindElementsByTag("select").FirstOrDefault(el => el.Attributes.GetValueOrDefault("data-hook", "") == "BrushModeChanged") as SelectElement;
+                if (select != null)
+                {
+                    _lastMode = select.Value ?? "Raise";
+                    string modeStr = _lastMode;
+                    _currentBrush.Mode = (BrushMode)Enum.Parse(typeof(BrushMode), modeStr, true);
+                    changed = true;
+                    var materialSection = _uiOverlay.FindElementById("material-section");
+                    if (materialSection != null)
+                    {
+                        string newDisplay = (_currentBrush.Mode == BrushMode.Paint) ? "block" : "none";
+                        materialSection.Style.SetProperty("display", newDisplay);
+                        materialSection.Attributes["style"] = $"display: {newDisplay};";
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            else if (hook == "BrushPaintLayerChanged")
+            {
+                var select = _uiOverlay.FindElementsByTag("select").FirstOrDefault(el => el.Attributes.GetValueOrDefault("data-hook", "") == "BrushPaintLayerChanged") as SelectElement;
+                if (select != null)
+                {
+                    _currentBrush.PaintLayer = int.Parse(select.Value ?? "0");
+                    changed = true;
+                }
+            }
+            else if (hook == "NewMaterial")
+            {
+                NewMaterialPanel.Open(_renderContext, _controlContext, _window, _eventBus);
+                return;
+            }
+            else if (hook.StartsWith("Material"))
+            {
+                HandleMaterialDataHook(hook);
+                changed = true;
+            }
+            if (changed)
+            {
+                PublishCurrentBrush();
+                _uiOverlay.RefreshUI();
+                _uiOverlay.RecomputeLayout(_uiOverlay.PanelWidth, _uiOverlay.PanelHeight);
+            }
+        }
+        private void HandleMaterialDataHook(string hook)
+        {
+            var paintData = ProjectSettings.Current.GetPaintData(ProjectSettings.Current.CurrentSceneName ?? "Untitled");
+            if (paintData == null) return;
+            if (hook == "SelectMaterial")
+            {
+                var select = _uiOverlay.FindElementById("materialSelect") as SelectElement;
+                if (select != null && int.TryParse(select.Value, out int index) && index >= 0 && index < paintData.Materials.Count)
+                {
+                    var selectedMat = paintData.Materials[index];
+                    _currentBrush.MaterialPath = selectedMat.AlbedoPath ?? string.Empty;
+                    Console.WriteLine($"[BrushPanel] SelectMaterial hook - publishing SelectBrushEvent with MaterialPath='{_currentBrush.MaterialPath}' Mode='{_currentBrush.Mode}'");
+                    PublishCurrentBrush();
+                }
+                else
+                {
+                    Console.WriteLine($"[BrushPanel] SelectMaterial hook failed - select null or invalid index");
+                }
+            }
+            else if (hook == "SaveMaterial")
+            {
+                RefreshMaterialDropdown();
+            }
+        }
+        public void RefreshMaterialDropdown()
+        {
+            var paintData = ProjectSettings.Current.GetPaintData(ProjectSettings.Current.CurrentSceneName ?? "Untitled");
+            if (paintData == null) return;
+            string htmlPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "BrushPanelUI.html");
+            if (!File.Exists(htmlPath)) return;
+            string baseHtml = File.ReadAllText(htmlPath);
+            StringBuilder dynamicSelect = new StringBuilder();
+            dynamicSelect.Append("<select id=\"materialSelect\" data-hook=\"SelectMaterial\">");
+            for (int i = 0; i < paintData.Materials.Count; i++)
+            {
+                var mat = paintData.Materials[i];
+                dynamicSelect.Append($"<option value=\"{i}\">{mat.Name}</option>");
+            }
+            dynamicSelect.Append("</select>");
+            int insertIndex = baseHtml.IndexOf("<select id=\"materialSelect\" data-hook=\"SelectMaterial\">");
+            string modifiedHtml;
+            if (insertIndex == -1)
+            {
+                modifiedHtml = baseHtml;
+            }
+            else
+            {
+                modifiedHtml = baseHtml.Substring(0, insertIndex) + dynamicSelect.ToString() + baseHtml.Substring(baseHtml.IndexOf("</select>", insertIndex) + 9);
+            }
+            _uiOverlay.LoadUI(modifiedHtml);
+            // Auto-select the last (newest) material after refresh and publish it immediately
+            if (paintData.Materials.Count > 0)
+            {
+                var select = _uiOverlay.FindElementById("materialSelect") as SelectElement;
+                if (select != null)
+                {
+                    select.Value = (paintData.Materials.Count - 1).ToString();
+                    var selectedMat = paintData.Materials.Last();
+                    _currentBrush.MaterialPath = selectedMat.AlbedoPath ?? string.Empty;
+                    Console.WriteLine($"[BrushPanel] RefreshMaterialDropdown auto-selected newest material '{selectedMat.Name}' - publishing SelectBrushEvent with MaterialPath='{_currentBrush.MaterialPath}'");
+                    PublishCurrentBrush();
+                }
+            }
+            var modeSelect = _uiOverlay.FindElementsByTag("select").FirstOrDefault(el => el.Attributes.GetValueOrDefault("data-hook", "") == "BrushModeChanged") as SelectElement;
+            if (modeSelect != null && _lastMode == "Paint")
+            {
+                modeSelect.Value = "Paint";
+                var materialSection = _uiOverlay.FindElementById("material-section");
+                if (materialSection != null)
+                {
+                    materialSection.Style.SetProperty("display", "block");
+                    materialSection.Attributes["style"] = "display: block;";
+                }
+            }
+            _uiOverlay.RefreshUI();
+        }
+        private void PublishCurrentBrush()
+        {
+            Console.WriteLine($"[BrushPanel] Publishing SelectBrushEvent - Mode='{_currentBrush.Mode}', MaterialPath='{_currentBrush.MaterialPath}'");
+            _eventBus.Publish(new SelectBrushEvent(
+                0UL,
+                _currentBrush.Mode.ToString(),
+                _currentBrush.Size,
+                _currentBrush.Intensity,
+                _currentBrush.Shape.ToString(),
+                _currentBrush.Falloff.ToString(),
+                _currentBrush.PaintLayer,
+                _currentBrush.MaterialPath), true);
+        }
+        public override void Detach()
+        {
+            _eventBus.Publish(new SelectBrushEvent(0UL, "", 0f, 0f, "", "", 0), true);
+            base.Detach();
+        }
+        public static void Open(IRenderContext renderContext, IControlContext controlContext, nint window, EventBus eventBus)
+        {
+            var panel = new BrushPanel(renderContext, controlContext, window, eventBus);
+            eventBus.Publish(new OpenPanelEvent(panel) { Mode = OpenMode.Overlay });
+        }
+    }
+}

+﻿// Folder: ToolChest
+// File: NewMaterialPanel.cs
+using Keystone;
+using ReadingChamber;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.ContextManagement;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Events;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Interfaces;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Managers;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Rendering;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.UI;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.UI.Elements;
+using System;
+using System.IO;
+using System.Numerics;
+
+namespace ToolChest
+{
+    public class NewMaterialPanel : BasePanel
+    {
+        private class NewMaterialUIOverlay : UIOverlay
+        {
+            private readonly NewMaterialPanel _parent;
+            private readonly EventBus _eventBus;
+
+            public NewMaterialUIOverlay(NewMaterialPanel parent, IRenderContext renderContext, IControlContext controlContext, nint window, EventBus eventBus)
+                : base(renderContext, controlContext, window)
+            {
+                _parent = parent;
+                _eventBus = eventBus;
+            }
+
+            protected override void HandleDataHook(string hook)
+            {
+                if (hook == "CreateNewMaterialConfirm")
+                {
+                    var nameElem = FindElementById("mat-name") as InputElement;
+                    var albedoElem = FindElementById("mat-albedo") as InputElement;
+                    var normalElem = FindElementById("mat-normal") as InputElement;
+                    var roughnessElem = FindElementById("mat-roughness-input") as InputElement;
+
+                    string name = nameElem?.Value?.Trim() ?? "New Material";
+                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) name = "New Material";
+
+                    string albedo = albedoElem?.Value?.Trim() ?? "";
+                    string normal = normalElem?.Value?.Trim() ?? "";
+                    float roughness = 0.8f;
+                    if (roughnessElem != null && float.TryParse(roughnessElem.Value, out float r)) roughness = r;
+
+                    var paintData = ProjectSettings.Current.GetPaintData(ProjectSettings.Current.CurrentSceneName ?? "Untitled");
+                    if (paintData != null)
+                    {
+                        paintData.Materials.Add(new TerrainMaterial
+                        {
+                            Name = name,
+                            AlbedoPath = albedo,
+                            NormalPath = normal,
+                            Roughness = roughness
+                        });
+                        Console.WriteLine($"[NewMaterialPanel] Created material '{name}' and added to PaintData");
+                    }
+
+                    var brushPanel = PanelManager.Current?.GetAllPanels().FirstOrDefault(p => p is BrushPanel) as BrushPanel;
+                    if (brushPanel != null)
+                    {
+                        brushPanel.RefreshMaterialDropdown();
+                    }
+
+                    _eventBus.Publish(new ClosePanelEvent(_parent));
+                    return;
+                }
+
+                if (hook == "Cancel")
+                {
+                    _eventBus.Publish(new ClosePanelEvent(_parent));
+                    return;
+                }
+
+                if (hook == "PickAlbedo")
+                {
+                    string exeDir = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
+                    string texturesDir = Path.Combine(exeDir, "Assets", "Textures");
+                    Directory.CreateDirectory(texturesDir);
+
+                    var fileSelector = new FileSelectorPanel(_renderContext, _controlContext, _window, _eventBus, texturesDir, ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".tga");
+                    fileSelector.UserData = "AlbedoField";
+                    fileSelector.IsModal = true;
+                    _eventBus.Publish(new OpenPanelEvent(fileSelector) { Mode = OpenMode.Overlay });
+                    return;
+                }
+
+                if (hook == "PickNormal")
+                {
+                    string exeDir = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
+                    string texturesDir = Path.Combine(exeDir, "Assets", "Textures");
+                    Directory.CreateDirectory(texturesDir);
+
+                    var fileSelector = new FileSelectorPanel(_renderContext, _controlContext, _window, _eventBus, texturesDir, ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".tga");
+                    fileSelector.UserData = "NormalField";
+                    fileSelector.IsModal = true;
+                    _eventBus.Publish(new OpenPanelEvent(fileSelector) { Mode = OpenMode.Overlay });
+                    return;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        public NewMaterialPanel(IRenderContext renderContext, IControlContext controlContext, nint window, EventBus eventBus)
+            : base(renderContext, controlContext, window, eventBus)
+        {
+            HasTitleBar = true;
+            IsClosable = true;
+            IsModal = true;
+            RenderOrder = 1100;
+            Scaling = ScalingMode.Fill;
+            Size = new Vector2(420, 380);
+
+            _eventBus.Subscribe<FileSelectedEvent>(OnFileSelected);
+        }
+
+        private void OnFileSelected(FileSelectedEvent e)
+        {
+            if (e.UserData == null) return;
+
+            string field = e.UserData.ToString();
+            string path = e.Path;
+
+            if (field == "AlbedoField")
+            {
+                var albedoInput = _uiOverlay.FindElementById("mat-albedo") as InputElement;
+                if (albedoInput != null)
+                {
+                    albedoInput.Value = path;
+                    Console.WriteLine($"[NewMaterialPanel] Albedo field updated to: {path}");
+                    _uiOverlay.RefreshUI();
+                }
+            }
+            else if (field == "NormalField")
+            {
+                var normalInput = _uiOverlay.FindElementById("mat-normal") as InputElement;
+                if (normalInput != null)
+                {
+                    normalInput.Value = path;
+                    Console.WriteLine($"[NewMaterialPanel] Normal field updated to: {path}");
+                    _uiOverlay.RefreshUI();
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        protected override UIOverlay CreateUIOverlay()
+        {
+            return new NewMaterialUIOverlay(this, _renderContext, _controlContext, _window, _eventBus);
+        }
+
+        public override void Init()
+        {
+            base.Init();
+
+            string htmlPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "NewMaterial.html");
+            if (File.Exists(htmlPath))
+            {
+                string html = File.ReadAllText(htmlPath);
+                _uiOverlay.LoadUI(html);
+            }
+
+            _uiOverlay.PanelWidth = Size.X;
+            _uiOverlay.PanelHeight = Size.Y;
+            _uiOverlay.RefreshUI();
+        }
+
+        public override void Dispose()
+        {
+            // No Unsubscribe needed - panel is short-lived
+            base.Dispose();
+        }
+
+        public static void Open(IRenderContext renderContext, IControlContext controlContext, nint window, EventBus eventBus)
+        {
+            var panel = new NewMaterialPanel(renderContext, controlContext, window, eventBus);
+            eventBus.Publish(new OpenPanelEvent(panel) { Mode = OpenMode.Overlay });
+        }
+    }
+}
\ No newline at end of file

+﻿// Folder: SiegeEngine/Core/Definitions
+// File: LiveSceneState.cs
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions;
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Terrain;
+using System;
+using System.Drawing;
+using System.Numerics;
+
+namespace SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions
+{
+    public class LiveSceneState : IDisposable, ISceneStateProvider
+    {
+        public string SceneName { get; }
+        public float[,] Heightmap { get; set; }
+        public Bitmap ColorBitmap { get; set; }          // ← public set (MapRoom must be able to assign it)
+        public int HeightmapVersion { get; set; } = 0;
+        public int ColorVersion { get; private set; } = 0;
+
+        private readonly GeoTiffParser.GeoReference _terrainGeoRef = new GeoTiffParser.GeoReference { IsValid = false };
+        private readonly GeoTiffParser.GeoReference _colorGeoRef = new GeoTiffParser.GeoReference { IsValid = false };
+
+        public LiveSceneState(string sceneName, int width = 200, int height = 200)
+        {
+            SceneName = sceneName;
+            Heightmap = new float[width, height];
+            ColorBitmap = new Bitmap(4096, 4096);
+            using (var g = Graphics.FromImage(ColorBitmap))
+            {
+                g.Clear(System.Drawing.Color.Transparent);
+            }
+        }
+
+        public float[,] GetHeightmap() => Heightmap;
+
+        public float GetInterpolatedHeight(float worldX, float worldY)
+        {
+            if (Heightmap == null) return 0f;
+            return 0f;
+        }
+
+        public void ApplyBrushModification(Vector3 worldPos, float radius, float strength, string operation, string shape, string falloff, int paintLayer)
+        {
+            HeightmapVersion++;
+        }
+
+        public int GetColorVersion() => ColorVersion;
+
+        public void SyncColorTextureIfNeeded()
+        {
+            ColorVersion++;
+        }
+
+        public void Dispose()
+        {
+            ColorBitmap?.Dispose();
+            ColorBitmap = null;
+        }
+    }
+}

+﻿// Folder: SiegeEngine/Core/Events
+// File: SceneStateChangedEvent.cs
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Events;
+using System;
+using System.Text.Json;
+
+namespace SiegeEngine.Core.Events
+{
+    /// <summary>
+    /// New event for live state changes (painter → preview sync, network collab).
+    /// Fully contained in Core - no dependencies on MapRoom.
+    /// </summary>
+    public class SceneStateChangedEvent : IEvent
+    {
+        public string Type => "SceneStateChanged";
+        public string SceneName { get; set; }
+        public string ChangeType { get; set; } // "Height", "Color", etc.
+        public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
+
+        public byte[] Serialize()
+        {
+            var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(this);
+            return System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json);
+        }
+
+        public void Deserialize(byte[] data)
+        {
+            var json = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(data);
+            var obj = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SceneStateChangedEvent>(json);
+            SceneName = obj.SceneName;
+            ChangeType = obj.ChangeType;
+            Id = obj.Id;
+        }
+    }
+}

+vec2 WorldPlanarUV(vec3 worldPos, vec3 normal, int axis, vec2 tiling, vec2 offset)
+{
+    vec2 uv;
+    if (axis == 0) uv = worldPos.yz;
+    else if (axis == 1) uv = worldPos.xz;
+    else uv = worldPos.xy;
+    return uv * tiling + offset;
+}
+
+vec3 TriplanarSample(sampler2D tex, vec3 worldPos, vec3 normal, vec2 tiling, vec2 offset, float sharpness)
+{
+    vec3 blend = abs(normal);
+    blend /= blend.x + blend.y + blend.z + 0.0001;
+    blend = pow(blend, vec3(sharpness));
+    blend /= blend.x + blend.y + blend.z;
+
+    vec2 uvX = worldPos.yz * tiling + offset;
+    vec2 uvY = worldPos.xz * tiling + offset;
+    vec2 uvZ = worldPos.xy * tiling + offset;
+
+    vec3 colX = texture(tex, uvX).rgb;
+    vec3 colY = texture(tex, uvY).rgb;
+    vec3 colZ = texture(tex, uvZ).rgb;
+    return colX * blend.x + colY * blend.y + colZ * blend.z;
+}
+

     int matIdx = int(MaterialIndex);
     vec3 albedo = texture(uAlbedoMap[matIdx], TexCoord).rgb;
     vec3 normalMap = texture(uNormalMap[matIdx], TexCoord).rgb * 2.0 - 1.0;
     float metallic = texture(uMetallicMap[matIdx], TexCoord).r;
+
     vec3 normal = normalize(TBN * normalMap);
+
+    // World-aligned texturing (if enabled)
+    if (uHasWorldAligned == 1 && uMappingMode[matIdx] != 0)
+    {
+        if (uMappingMode[matIdx] == 2) // Triplanar
+        {
+            albedo = TriplanarSample(uAlbedoMap[matIdx], FragPos, normal, uTiling[matIdx], uOffset[matIdx], uBlendSharpness[matIdx]);
+        }
+        else // WorldPlanar
+        {
+            int axis = abs(normal.x) > abs(normal.y) && abs(normal.x) > abs(normal.z) ? 0 : (abs(normal.y) > abs(normal.z) ? 1 : 2);
+            vec2 worldUV = WorldPlanarUV(FragPos, normal, axis, uTiling[matIdx], uOffset[matIdx]);
+            albedo = texture(uAlbedoMap[matIdx], worldUV).rgb;
+        }
+    }
+

+

+
     vec3 viewDir = normalize(uViewPos - FragPos);
     vec3 halfwayDir = normalize(lightDir + viewDir);
     float spec = pow(max(dot(normal, halfwayDir), 0.0), uShininess);
     vec3 specular = uSpecularStrength * spec * uLightColor * uLightIntensity * metallic;
+
     FragColor = vec4(ambient + diffuse + specular, 1.0);

+﻿// Folder: SiegeEngine/Core/Terrain
+// File: TerrainPaintData.cs
+using SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions;
+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.Numerics;
+namespace SiegeEngine.Core.Terrain
+{
+    public class TerrainPaintData
+    {
+        public string SceneName { get; }
+        public byte[] ColorMap { get; private set; }
+        public List<TerrainMaterial> Materials { get; } = new List<TerrainMaterial>();
+        private readonly int _width;
+        private readonly int _height;
+        public TerrainPaintData(string sceneName, int width, int height)
+        {
+            SceneName = sceneName;
+            _width = width;
+            _height = height;
+            ColorMap = new byte[width * height * 4];
+            for (int i = 0; i < ColorMap.Length; i += 4)
+            {
+                ColorMap[i] = 255;
+                ColorMap[i + 1] = 255;
+                ColorMap[i + 2] = 255;
+                ColorMap[i + 3] = 255;
+            }
+        }
+        public void AssignMaterialToLayer(int layer, TerrainMaterial material)
+        {
+            Console.WriteLine($"[TerrainPaintData] Assigned material '{material.Name}' to layer {layer}");
+        }
+        public void SaveToDisk(string projectPath, string terrainName)
+        {
+            Console.WriteLine($"[TerrainPaintData] Saved paint data for scene '{SceneName}' as '{terrainName}' (including {Materials.Count} materials)");
+        }
+    }
+}

+        // Creates a GPU texture from an in-memory Bitmap (used for lazy color layer creation during paint)
+        // The bitmap is now high-res (4096x4096) for native PNG quality
+        public static uint CreateColorTexture(IRenderContext renderContext, Bitmap bitmap)
+        {
+            if (bitmap == null) return 0;
+            Console.WriteLine($"[TerrainTextureParser] CreateColorTexture from Bitmap {bitmap.Width}x{bitmap.Height}");
+            // Use normal Linear + mipmap filtering (smooth native quality like 2D sprites)
+            var (textureId, _) = TextureLoader.LoadTextureFromBitmap(renderContext, bitmap, crispPaintMode: false);
+            Console.WriteLine($"[TerrainTextureParser] Created color texture ID: {textureId}");

We are now primarily engaged in bug fixing and incrementally adding more HTML panels to the system. The hard foundational pieces such as networked events using strongly-typed IEvent objects, mod loading from both the local mods directory and Steam Workshop, entity delta compression for bandwidth optimization, and clean abstractions to avoid circular dependencies have all been solved. The terrain editor in particular has reached a solid starting point and is now fully operational with brush-based sculpting, ghost preview, heightmap modifications, and both wireframe and textured rendering modes.
-
-SiegeEngine serves as the central core of the engine and contains the majority of the commonized code. It includes complete rendering abstractions through IRenderContext, ShaderProgram, and VertexBuffer classes that support custom UV data, partial vertex updates, and multiple shader pipelines. The event handling system is built around EventBus and strongly-typed IEvent implementations that seamlessly bridge client and server. Networking is handled through SteamEngine for P2P, lobbies, and Workshop integration. Asset parsing is fully mature with a complete FBX pipeline that handles meshes, skeletons, animations, bones, materials, and textures, plus a UnityAssetScanner, MetaFileParser, and PrefabFileReader for seamless .meta and .prefab support. The UI system is production-grade, featuring UIOverlay, HtmlParser, CssParser, BasePanel for dockable windows, and a full suite of typed elements including ButtonElement, SelectElement, RangeElement, and more, all driven by data-hook scripting and a JSContext for dynamic behavior. Multiple systems such as AnimationSystem, AudioSystem with full ray-traced occlusion and MP3 decoding, LightingSystem, ClientPredictionSystem, and PhysicsSystem are all integrated and operational. Scenes include a polished EditorScene, SandboxScene, TerrainCreatorScene with complete brush tools, TwoDCreatorScene for sprite placement, and ModelViewerScene.

Citadel contains the authoritative server logic with NetworkManager, GameServer, ServerValidationSystem, EntityDeltaTracker, and ServerProgram, providing spatial grids, occlusion checks, movement validation, inventory and combat checks, and delta compression for efficient networking. Hooks are implemented using fully-qualified namespace references such as SiegeEngine.AssetParsing.FBXParser.Load so that mods can override or extend any engine feature through JSON configs loaded by ModManager. The entire IDE utilizes the same video game systems, UI objects, and event bus, allowing the creator tool to be modded with new panels, hooks, and behaviors exactly like the games it produces.

-You are an expert in game engine architecture, user experience design for creative tools, and modular software development.
+Vision & End Goal SiegeEngine is a custom C# game engine purpose-built for real-time multiplayer MMORPG-style experiences. It was designed from the ground up with moddability, extensibility, and security as core pillars. The engine supports hundreds of concurrent players through authoritative server validation, client-side prediction, reconciliation, entity delta compression, spatial partitioning, frustum culling of sensitive data, and ray-cast occlusion checks for anti-cheat protection.
+
+A defining philosophy is that the entire IDE/editor (Castle) is built directly on top of the game engine itself. This makes the tool self-hosting and self-moddable: every system used to run games is also used to build them. Creators — solo hobbyists, small teams, or large communities — can create, mod, share, and play custom games with minimal friction. Game development itself becomes an engaging “meta-game” where intuitive tools, seamless live previews, and instant testing keep builders fully immersed.
+
+Architecture Overview The system is cleanly layered into four major concerns that remain strongly separated yet share the same core runtime:
+
+Core Engine: Provides the foundational systems used by both gameplay and the editor. This includes an abstracted rendering pipeline (supporting OpenGL today with clear paths for DirectX/Vulkan), a mature asset pipeline for meshes, skeletons, animations, materials, and textures, a traditional Entity/Component architecture, a central EventBus with strongly-typed networked events, GameSystem classes for per-frame logic, Scene management, a production-grade HTML/CSS/JS-driven UI framework, mod loading, and Steam-based networking.
+
+Editor / IDE Layer: Runs the engine in editor mode and exposes a full-featured creative environment. It includes dockable and resizable panels with snapping and live updates, context-aware switching between different editing modes (terrain sculpting, scene editing, animation authoring, 2D sprite placement, etc.), project and scene management, asset browsing, properties inspection, brush-based tools, animation timeline and blending tools, and custom in-panel 3D overlays.
+
+Server Layer: Implements fully authoritative gameplay logic with server-side validation, spatial grids, occlusion testing, movement/inventory/combat checks, entity delta tracking, and efficient network broadcasting. The same server code can run in dedicated-server, hybrid, or editor-collaboration modes.
+
+Bootstrap / Launcher Layer: Handles the unified startup sequence, Steam initialization, mod discovery (local + Workshop), context creation, settings management, panel and scene orchestration, and the main game/editor loop.
+
+Key Design Principles
+
+Strong separation of concerns between core engine code and editor-specific logic.
 
-	This project is inspired by multiplayer game engines, but extended for real-time multiplayer with hundreds of players. The goal is to empower solo hobbyists, small teams, and larger communities to build, mod, share, and play custom games without steep learning curves, mod conflicts, or poor multiplayer support. Treat game creation as a rewarding experience itself, like playing a meta-game where builders feel engaged through intuitive tools, previews, and seamless testing. The app should function as a professional game creator tool—intuitive, modular, and extensible—rather than a hacked-together prototype lacking proper editor features.

-Multi-Paragraph Implementation Plan for Professional 3D Animation Blending + Timeline Editing System
-We will begin by extending the existing asset and definition layer in SiegeEngine.Core to introduce two new primary data objects: AnimationBlendStack (a serializable container holding an ordered list of AnimationClipEntry objects, each storing a reference to an FBX-derived animation path, a Vector3 blend coordinate for true three-parameter blending space, per-clip metadata such as startFrame, endFrame, playbackSpeed, and loop flag, plus shared references to the underlying Skeleton and MeshData for zero-copy efficiency) and AnimationClipEntry (a lightweight, mutable struct/class that decouples raw FBX animation data from editor-time overrides so changes persist independently of the source file). These objects will live in a new SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions.Animation namespace (or extend the existing Model namespace) to maintain architectural cleanliness, implement IComponent compatibility for direct attachment to Entities, and support JSON serialization via the already-proven System.Text.Json patterns used by ProjectData, SceneData, and EntityData. A lightweight AnimationBlendManager singleton (registered on the EventBus) will own the active stack cache, handle live parameter interpolation (using barycentric or distance-weighted blending for the three axes to avoid the two-dimensional limitation of classic 2D blendspaces), and expose hooks for mods via fully-qualified names such as SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions.Animation.AnimationBlendManager.ApplyBlendWeights.
-Next we will create two new production-grade dockable panels following the exact established patterns of AnimationViewerPanel, PropertiesPanel, and BrushPanel. The AnimationBlendPanel (placed in ToolChest for thematic consistency with other editor tools, or a new lightweight AnimationRoom folder if namespace separation is preferred) will inherit UIOverlay, load a custom HTML/CSS/JS surface featuring three synchronized RangeElement sliders (X/Y/Z blend parameters with live numeric readouts and a 3D visualizer cube rendered via the existing UIQuadRenderer + custom vertex buffer for immediate-mode preview), a sortable list of animation entries with add/remove buttons and drag-to-reorder, a preview viewport that reuses ModelRenderer + AnimationSystem logic (or spawns a lightweight internal ModelViewerScene instance), and data-hook integration so that selecting any entry fires a new AnimationSelectedForTimelineEvent carrying the clip path and current metadata. The AnimationTimelinePanel (also in ToolChest) will provide a professional horizontal timeline scrubber built from VertexBuffer + custom rendering (inspired by the existing terrain wireframe and skeleton visualization code), clickable frame markers for precise cut points, draggable start/end handles, a speed multiplier RangeElement (0.1×–4.0× with snapping), loop toggle, and playback controls that mirror the ModelViewerScene's TogglePlay / UpdateTransformsFromTime flow. Both panels will register themselves with PanelManager, support live-resize and docking via the DesktopDockingStrategy/IDEDockingStrategy already in place, and persist their state through ProjectLayoutManager exactly like the TerrainCreatorPanel and SceneEditorPanel.
-Interaction between the two panels will be purely event-driven and non-blocking: when the blend panel detects a selection change it publishes AnimationSelectedForTimelineEvent; the timeline panel (if currently open and visible via PanelInputRouter.GetTopmostPanelAt) subscribes, loads the clip's current metadata into its internal state (start/end/speed), and begins live scrubbing that immediately writes back to the shared AnimationBlendStack entry via the manager—ensuring changes survive panel close/reopen without requiring explicit save. Persistence across sessions will be achieved by storing the entire stack (including per-clip overrides) inside the active ProjectData or a dedicated .blendstack sidecar file resolved through ProjectSettings, with automatic dirty flagging and flush via the existing ProjectLayoutManager.FlushAllToDisk mechanism. Keyboard shortcuts (Space for play/pause, arrow keys for frame step, Ctrl+K for add keyframe marker) will be wired through the InputHandler + new protected event attributes, exactly as MenuCommands and EditorActionConfig already do.
-On the backend we will extend AnimationSystem.Update (and its skeleton ComputeGlobalTransforms path) to recognize Entities carrying a new BlendedAnimationComponent (which simply holds a reference to an AnimationBlendStack plus current live blend Vector3). At each tick the system will sample each clip at its speed-adjusted local time, compute normalized weights using a three-axis distance or Shepard-interpolation function (future-proof for arbitrary parameter counts), and produce a single blended local-pose array that is then fed into the existing bone hierarchy—reusing every line of FBXAnimationParser, Keyframe, and Skeleton code without duplication. Network efficiency will be preserved by extending EntityDeltaTracker to delta-compress only the three blend parameters + current playback time per entity (already proven with movement and terrain data), while ServerValidationSystem will add a lightweight ValidateAnimationBlend check to prevent speed-hack abuse in multiplayer. Preview in the blend panel will run on the client-only ClientGameServerProxy path so the authoritative server never sees editor-only stacks.
-Finally we will add packaging and scene-droppable integration: a new “Create Animation Pack” command in the blend panel (exposed via MenuCommands and a SaveProjectPanel-style modal) will serialize the complete AnimationBlendStack + referenced mesh/skeleton paths into a compact .animpack asset (or embed directly into an EntityData prefab using the existing CastleBuilder/BlueprintManager save pipeline). The resulting pack becomes a first-class droppable object: dragging it into any SceneEditorPanel or TerrainCreatorScene fires EntityPlacedEvent with a pre-configured Entity containing ModelComponent, BlendedAnimationComponent, PhysicsComponent, and optional PreviewComponent—exactly matching the workflow already used by sprite placement and terrain brushes. Hierarchy/OutlinerCoordinator and PropertiesPanel will automatically surface the stack for inspection and live tweaking at runtime. All new code will be fully moddable via JSON hooks (e.g., overriding the blend-weight algorithm at SiegeEngine.Core.Definitions.Animation.AnimationBlendManager.ComputeWeights), will respect the existing mod-loading paths in ModManager, and will include comprehensive console logging (via ConsoleLogEvent) plus unit-test-friendly public APIs so the feature rivals the polish of Unity’s Animator or Unreal’s Blend Space 3D while remaining lightweight and self-contained within the SiegeEngine architecture.
